metas.name: 999: Emergency Call Out
metas.description: Documentary following joint police and paramedic fast response units, with both emergency services travelling together in one high-performance vehicle.

metas.name: Fresh Cops
metas.description: On the front line of crime. Stop and search, sudden deaths and rural robberies - new recruits from Leicestershire's diverse communities take on the highs and lows of policing.

metas.name: Police 999: Clear & Present Danger
metas.description: With unprecedented access to shocking police body-worn camera footage, we step into the shoes of heroic officers fighting crime and tackling some of the country's most violent and dangerous criminals.

metas.name: Sky Coppers
metas.description: Behind the scenes with the West Midlands Police Drone Unit who hunt criminals from the sky. Drone tech is a specialist ultra-modern tool that has the capacity to help officers as they conduct investigatations and attempt to track criminals. The Unit pursues suspected wrongdoers as they try to hide up in the trees, discard drugs, or run away from the scene of a crime. The Sky Coppers make it a point to watch from above because, as they know from experience, criminals always forget to look up.

metas.name: Hotel Custody
metas.description: Explores the day-to-day workings of a modern and busy custody suite, the ‘gateway’ for anyone entering the criminal justice system. From first-time lawbreakers to repeat offenders, from drink drivers to armed robbers, shedding light on the faces and stories behind the people that soon become just another crime statistic.

metas.name: Inside the Force: 24/7
metas.description: Documentary going behind the scenes at Lincoln's West Parade police station, beginning by focusing on the custody suite as a procession of challenging suspects is brought in.

metas.name: 999 Police: Hour of Duty
metas.description: Real-time documentary following police officers on duty between 9pm and 10pm.

metas.name: Police Code Zero: Officer Under Attack
metas.description: Documentary series exposing the dangerous situations faced by our police forces.
